deskyard device revoke: sign out a device

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] device revoke ID [--account USER]

Revokes a CLI credential by its ID (from device list), closing its connections
at once. To sign out this CLI, use `deskyard logout` instead.

Arguments:
  ID         string      required  credential ID

Options:
  --account USER       another account's device (admin)

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard device revoke 3f9c0a12
  deskyard device revoke 3f9c0a12 --account anna

Where: on this machine, talking to the chosen server: the one -e SERVER/ (or -e SERVER/ENV) names, else the default server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; the server's refusal (403 for what your account may not do) is an error
